candidates.name: Hardy Storage pipeline and Columbia VA loops
candidates.sponsor: Columbia Gas Transmission / Hardy Storage Company LLC

evidence.note: FERC EA: Hardy LLC about 36.8 mi pipeline in WV; Columbia three 24-in loops totaling about 30.2 mi in VA

candidates.why_maybe_new: EIA 33.5 mi VA,MD likely the Columbia VA loops (about 30.2 mi per EA); Hardy's own WV line (~36.8 mi) is a separate pipe. No GEM row for either. EIA state list looks off; confirm which line to track.

candidates.name: Cardinal Pipeline

evidence.note: Cardinal Pipeline contracts release, North Carolina
describes Cardinal as 105-mi 24-in line, Rockingham County to southeast of Raleigh

candidates.why_maybe_new: Intrastate NC trunk; no GEM row. EIA says 67 mi, trade press says 105 mi total (extensions later); length conflict to settle at vetting. Operator is Cardinal Pipeline Co, not Transco.

candidates.name: Elba Express Bridge Project

candidates.why_maybe_new: Greenfield 71 mi extension; no GEM row (P3295 is the existing Elba Express). Same project listed twice in EIA (Bridge Project, Elba Express Bridge Project (EEBP)).
